description: Source file implementing the SourceFile class and related functions for handling source file types, extensions, and path normalization within the build system.

classes.name: SourceFile
classes.description: Represents a source file with methods to determine its type, name, directory, and path resolution.

classes.name: SourceFileTypeSet
classes.description: Manages a set of source file types used in build configurations.

methods.name: GetSourceFileType
methods.description: Determines the source file type based on file extension.

methods.name: IsDefType
methods.description: Checks if the file is a definition type based on extension.

methods.name: IsObjectType
methods.description: Checks if the file is an object file based on extension.

methods.name: IsModuleMapType
methods.description: Checks if the file is a module map.

methods.name: IsSwiftType
methods.description: Checks if the file is a Swift source file.

methods.name: IsSwiftModuleType
methods.description: Checks if the file is a Swift module.

methods.name: GetName
methods.description: Returns the filename component of the source file path.

methods.name: GetDir
methods.description: Returns the directory component of the source file path.

methods.name: Resolve
methods.description: Resolves the source file path relative to a source root.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets the internal path value of the source file.
